You see a fridge. The fridge contains a white onion. You see a closed oven. You rest your hand against a wall, but you miss the wall and fall onto a table. On the table you can see a cookbook. You make out a counter. The counter is vast. On the counter you make out a raw red potato and a red onion. Look over there! a stove. Now why would someone leave that there? However, the stove, like an empty stove, has nothing on it.

There is a closed screen door leading east. There is a closed frosted-glass door leading north. There is an exit to the south. Don't worry, there is no door.

There is a carrot, a red apple and a raw purple potato on the floor.
